description: Given a `dry_run` report and a config, attribute EACH proposed update to the `packageRules` that matched it — answering "which of my rules produced these updates?". Stateless and offline: run `dry_run` first, then pass its report here (inline `report`, `reportPath`, or `logPath` — a Renovate JSON-lines debug log from a real bot run; same shapes as `dry_run_diff`) plus a config source (`repoPath` or `configContent`). Each update is matched with Renovate's REAL matchers in a worker thread against the facts present in the report; fields the report doesn't carry (e.g. datasource, depType) are reported under each update's `unevaluatable` and aggregated in `fieldGaps` rather than silently treated as non-matches. `rulesNeverMatched` flags likely-dead rules. Deprecated matcher keys are warned about — run migrate_config first. Run dry_run for full-fidelity confirmation.

configContent.description: Inline config object whose packageRules to attribute against. Use instead of repoPath.

endpoint.description: API base URL that `local>` presets are fetched from (with `platform`) — same semantics as resolve_config.

externalPresets.description: When true, fetch external presets (github>, gitlab>, gitea>, forgejo>) so their packageRules are included — same semantics as resolve_config. Default false.

logPath.description: Absolute path to a Renovate JSON-lines debug log from a real run (`LOG_LEVEL=debug LOG_FORMAT=json`), read as a report. Use instead of report / reportPath.

platform.description: The platform `local>` presets live on — same semantics as resolve_config (routes only; never moves a token).

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root; the tool locates and expands its renovate config to get the packageRules. Use instead of configContent.

report.description: A Renovate dry-run report — the raw report (`{ repositories }`) or a full `dry_run` summary (`{ report }`); the tool unwraps `report` automatically. Use instead of reportPath.

reportPath.description: Absolute path to a JSON file containing the report (pair with `dry_run`'s reportOutputPath). Use instead of report.

name: annotate_dry_run
title: Attribute dry_run updates to packageRules
